english.note: Use this when stressing that someone repays kindness with ingratitude; it is less common in everyday Hong Kong speech than the other choices.

examples.english: I once saved them, but they betrayed me right afterward—they’re a real ingrate.
examples.traditional: 我救過佢一次，點知佢轉頭就出賣我，真係白眼狼。
